title: Keto Italian Chicken Skewers
description: A flavorful and healthy keto meal, perfect for a quick dinner. Marinated chicken breast is grilled to perfection and served with a side of roasted vegetables.
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together Italian dressing, olive oil, garlic, salt, and pepper.
Add the chicken breast to the bowl and marinate for at least 30 minutes, or up to 2 hours in the refrigerator.
Thread the marinated chicken onto the robust skewers.
Grill the skewers for 8-10 minutes, or until the chicken is cooked through and the internal temperature reaches 165°F.
Serve immediately, garnished with fresh basil.
